source_matrix_schema.core_decomposition: for hidden-pair layouts, fix all visible carrier primes and sum the excess net-zero block over q in K; omitted q is every source-admissible prime <=N outside K and visible carrier primes. section_root_identity: after common translation, coefficient u^h is c0^h*lambda^h/n * sum_(j=0)^h (-minprefix)^(h-j)*S_j(n-span)/((h-j)!*j!), S_j(M)=sum_(r=0)^(M-1)r^j
